title: NORD-10 Input/Output bus at an I/O device card position

conventions.active: low = true when the line is low (ND suffix 0); high = true when high (suffix 1); none = power
conventions.direction: seen from an I/O card: in, out, bidir, 'out, open collector (shared)'
conventions.confidence: read = stated in the source; inferred = worked out, the note says from what; open = not known
conventions.pins: connector 'open' = no NORD-10 document found names the connector; pin = the number in the wiring list and on the card drawings
conventions.letters: In Backwiring til NORD-10 a letter before a signal code (W, G, B, E, X) is printed. G marks the driving pin (inferred from the IDENT/GRANT chains); X marks a signal with only one connection (inferred from the chain ends); W, B and E are open.

sources.document: Backwiring til NORD-10 (A/S Norsk Data-Elektronikk): connector specification list, connector lists per card position, signal code list
sources.note: Typed wiring list of the NORD-10 CPU crate. The connector lists of A22 and A25 were checked against the page images; the OCR of the other slot pages agrees with them pin for pin.

sources.document: NORD-10 drawings, sheet 2A50 SYNCHRONOUS MODEM BUFFER 1050 (1973), as read pin by pin in this repository (sheets/nord-10/2A50-sync-modem-buffer-1050.rsc, docs/2A50-reading.md)
sources.note: The names the card drawing uses (LEV10, IOXE, MC ...) differ from the backplane names (BINT10, BIOXE, BMCL ...); the pin numbers match.

sources.document: ND-06.008.01 NORD-10/S Reference Manual, Revision A
sources.note: Sections 3.3 (IOX), IDENT instruction, 4.1 (Input/Output hardware) and 4.1.3 (vectored interrupt identification). It refers to the NORD-10 Input/Output manual ND-06.004 for signal levels, definitions and timing; that manual was NOT found on this machine.

active.page: connector lists of the I/O device positions A25-A32: PDF pages 28-35, printed pages 26-33
active.note: Every bus name in the list carries the suffix 0. That suffix 0 means 'true when low' is stated for the NORD-100 bus (ND-06.016.01 Appendix F.1); no NORD-10 document found states it, but the 2A50 drawing uses the same suffix and drives these lines with open-collector gates.
